_comment: Every executable change after the comment-only cleanup, with the items it closes. tools/check_equivalence.py refuses a changed, added or deleted KRL file that is not listed here. base = the cleanup commit (tools/check_cleanup.py --head BASE proves it changed only comments).

changes.what: Literal I/O addresses replaced by declared signal names outside KUKA inline forms: pedestal valves and switches (AutomationCore names do498UpperPinExtend, do499UpperPinRetract, do501PartClampClose, do502PartClampOpen, do503QFPAdvance, do504QFPReturn, do505QFPNutBlowOff, di466PartClampOpen, di467PartClampClosed, di470QFPAdvanced renamed from their Reserved names), NutWeld dopw1_/dipw1_ names, the water output and hopper lights in sps.sub, and the three KL50L2 beacon bits declared as CL_BeaconBit3001/3008/3024. Same addresses.

Named constants in $config.dat (fold CENTERLINE CONTROL) for the gun stroke window (CL_GUN_WELD_MIN/MAX, now 69000/73000 = the window the code always checked; they were declared 65000/76000 and unused), gun-open limit, gun-closed timeout and time in window, the three pressure words as used in production (CL_GUN_PRESS_BASE 405, CL_GUN_PRESS_WELD 1820, CL_GUN_PRESS_REST 39425 - byte order still to confirm, F44) and the Bosch weld program. CENTERLINE_WELD and CENTERLINE_HOME use them. Same values.

Every GOTO and label removed: dry-cycle skips as IF NOT di004UseDryCycle (picks, weld apps, nut check), the preloaded-nut skip in CENTERLINE_WELD as IF NOT NUT_READY, the gun-closed check as LOOP/EXIT, Style1Opt1 as one IF/ELSE path per cycle (station read once into nPickStation). Behaviour kept except F07: after the HALT of the gun-closed timeout both timers restart, so a second timeout is possible.
Dead nut-weld retry removed (as on R20): RETRY_NUT1 labels, the IF NUT_WELD_RETRY blocks and the NUT_WELD_RETRY declaration. NUT_WELD_RETRY was never set TRUE, so no path changes.

Hand-typed lines taken out of inline-form folds: the next-nut TRIGGERs (NUT_START in the picks at P12/P10, Request_next_nut() in apps 1 and 2 at P0, DISTANCE kept 0 and 1) now stand right before their motion fold (KUKA SYN OUT placement, same motion, same trigger point); the red rabbit resets after the DropOff[2] Reset fold. A Touch Up can no longer delete them.

Picks: the gripper-empty wait (part present switches di253/di254 OFF) moved before the first gripper command instead of after it. The hidden GripperTech parameters of the gripper 1 SET forms in the picks and the conveyor drop corrected to the gripper and state the code uses (were setgripper=4;setstate=2 - an inactive gripper): a Touch Up no longer turns them into commands for gripper 4.

Nut presence check: each of the 3 checks is now 'dwell 0.2 s, PARTPRESENTn = di227NutPresent1' (was a set-only IF reading the sensor before the dwell). The read happens with the robot standing at the point and a missing nut writes FALSE. bscrapGE4 start-of-cycle reset not done (needs F02).

Redundant code removed: the GRPg_Check that repeated the check GRPg_SetStateAndCheck had just done (picks: open and close; conveyor drop; RejectGE4), the doubled upper-pin-extend lines on the local-feed path of CENTERLINE_WELD, the unused WELD_END label.

Identifiers in correct English and one name for $IN[227]: NUT_STAR -> NUT_START, di100/di101CameraJudment -> CameraJudgment, do106/di106PartRejeted -> PartRejected, di227SensorCamera -> di227NutPresent1 with the NUT_PRESENT1 declaration of $config.dat removed. Folder Program/Styles/optiones renamed Options (moved_files).

Programmer's change of 2026-10-05, integrated: GUN_OPEN_CHECK (submit running, air if enabled, cooling water, gun open 137000..142000 with message and wait) before each pedestal entry and after the gun opens in CENTERLINE_WELD (replaces WAIT FOR LPT > 120000; CL_GUN_OPEN_MIN removed); interrupts 20-22 (gun out of the open range or submit stopped -> GUN_OPEN_LOST: BRAKE F, quit message, wait) on while the robot moves into and out of the pedestal, off at the weld position.

Programmer's change of 2026-10-05, integrated: dipw1_WaterOk from the SV0500 flow (nWaterFlow = word / 4, OK at >= nWaterFlowMin 150, not OK below 140) instead of TRUE in both branches; the water valve $OUT[475] dopw1_StartWater follows $IN[13] di013WaterEnable instead of ON outside dry cycle.

Programmer's change of 2026-10-05, integrated: the nut sensor and the camera decide by nOption: production options 1, 2, 7, 8 set bscrapGE4 (camera without a valid OK result = scrap); red rabbit option 12 sets $OUT[141] / $OUT[142] (was CASE 10, never sent).

Programmer's change of 2026-10-05, integrated: AutomationCore_BKG called in sps.sub; vendor routine edited (nut welder 2-3 outputs removed, AC_Request_to_enter latches bACEntryGranted instead of waiting in the submit), bACEntryGranted declared; NutWeld nMaxGunNr = 1 and dipw1_AirOK moved to the new TBEN input $IN[3132].

Controller files taken as they are from the programmer's backup bmw_03_10_r1 (2026-10-05): machine data, $custom.dat and tm_bib.dat (WorkVisual formatting and runtime values), GripperTech data (same configuration, regenerated), together with the robot name, the I/O mapping of the new TBEN module and the WorkVisual projects (not KRL).

AtDrop3 as re-taught by the programmer on 2026-10-05 (B 4.3 -> 30.1 deg, C -0.3 -> -34.8 deg): the part falls better on the conveyor; validated by Edgar Montiel with the programmer. The drop-off interlock AC_DropOffCheck(1) stays before the first motion (the programmer's move after P5/P1 is not taken).

Programmer's change of 2026-10-05 14:46, integrated: the three weld apps are split per pick station, A for parts from pickup 1 (positions unchanged) and B for pickup 2 (weld positions P19/P20 of nut 1, P16 of nuts 2 and 3 re-taught 1-5 mm); Style1Opt1 calls A or B by nPickStation. Camera point P3 re-taught (style1app2opt2.dat).

Independent review of 2026-10-05: the gun monitoring interrupts 20-22 are switched on before each GUN_OPEN_CHECK (on entry and again after CENTERLINE_WELD), because they fire only on a change; GUN_OPEN_LOST shows a state message while it waits after the acknowledgement.

Independent review of 2026-10-05: application 1 is no longer released at the camera point (the robot then waited there for the drop-off with application 1 clear); $OUT[70] do070ApplicationClear1 is set by a TRIGGER on the first motion away from the camera: P5 of the conveyor drop, P23 of RejectGE4 (also after a sensor scrap, which never released it), P28 of the red-rabbit drop.

AutomationCore_BKG switched off again until Gestamp decides and its problems are fixed (F49); the submit clears $OUT[145] doCriticalWZ and $OUT[111] do111Gun1ElectrodeChange at start, outputs the task may have left on. The programmer's edits inside the vendor routine stay (inactive, C28). The other PLC status outputs only that task writes ($OUT[6..10], 13, 21, 22, 46, 48, 50-60, 94, 97-105, 107, 118, 123, 124, 134, 146, 464) are cleared at submit start as well, as in the program as received (independent review).

Cycle time, stage 1: the next nut is fed into the shuttle while the robot moves in and welds. Weld apps 1-2 set NUT_FEED_START at the wait point when their nut is ready (no preload running, not dry cycle); PRELOAD then runs step 0 only (feed 2000 ms, feed off at the end of the step) and waits for NUT_LOAD_OK, which Request_next_nut gives (NUT_START) with the robot clear: app 1 at P8 as before, app 2 at P05 (trigger DISTANCE 1 -> 0, P05 is 4 mm from P5). A NUT_START with no preload running feeds and loads as before. PRELOAD writes $OUT[494] dopw1_BlowOff in step 0 only with the load allowed; CENTERLINE_WELD switches $OUT[476] dopw1_StartFeed off only when no preload is running. Step 20 ends when the QFP is seen returned ($IN[482] on, $IN[470] off) instead of 800 ms after the return command ($TIMER[12] no longer used, F13). On completion NUTCYCLE_ACTIVE is cleared before the ready flags. New flags NUT_FEED_START and NUT_LOAD_OK in $config.dat.

Cycle-time measurement: CL_CYCLE_TIME (new module) records $TIMER[20] in ms from the robot stopped at the wait point of each weld app (CL_CYCLE_START, after a WAIT SEC 0 at the point where the robot already stops for the nut wait) to the nut ready (step 1) and to 12 steps of CENTERLINE_WELD (2-13), last 10 cycles per nut, in CL_CYCLE_TIME.dat. Only writes its own data and $TIMER[20]: no signal, wait or motion. To remove when the cycle-time work is closed.
